{"status": "NO_PLAN", "reasons": ["CS2102 prerequisite requires CS2030S/CS2030/CS2030DE/CS2030HS/YSC2229/CS2040/CS2040C/CS2040S/CS2040DE/CS2040HS. Student has CS2030S and CS2040S, so prerequisite is met. However, CS2102 is blocked by 'cannot take if completed: CS2102S or IT2002'. Student has not completed these, so this is fine. Wait, check CS2102 record: 'cannot take if completed: CS2102S or IT2002'. Student has not completed CS2102S or IT2002. So CS2102 is eligible. But wait, look at CS2102 prerequisites again: '(CS1231 or MA1100 or MA1100T or CS1231S) and (CS2030S or CS2030 or CS2030DE or CS2030HS or YSC2229 or CS2040 or CS2040C or CS2040S or CS2040DE or CS2040HS)'. Student has CS1231S, CS2030S, CS2040S. Prereqs met. CS2102 is offered Sem 1, Sem 2. Student wants it in Sem 7. Sem 7 is odd, so it is offered. CS4218 requires CS3213 or CS3219. Student has CS3219. CS4218 is offered Sem 1, Sem 2. Sem 7 is odd, so offered. CS3210 requires CS2100/CS2100DE/CS2100HS/CG2007/EE2028/CG2028/EE2024. Student has CS2100. CS3210 is offered Sem 1, Sem 2. Sem 7 is odd, so offered. CS3103 requires CS2105/EE3204/EE3204E/EE4204. Student has CS2105. CS3103 is offered Sem 1. Sem 7 is odd, so offered. CS3227 requires CS2103/CS2103T/CS2113/CS2103DE. Student has CS2103T. CS3227 is offered Sem 1, Sem 2. Sem 7 is odd, so offered. CS3282 requires CS3281. Student has NOT completed CS3281. CS3281 is a prerequisite for CS3282. Student did not list CS3281 as completed. Student needs CS3282. Therefore, student must take CS3281. CS3281 requires CS2103/CS2103T/CS2103DE/CS2113. Student has CS2103T. So CS3281 is eligible. CS3281 is offered Sem 2. Sem 7 is odd, so CS3281 CANNOT be taken in Sem 7. CS3282 requires CS3281. So CS3282 must be after CS3281. If CS3281 is in Sem 6 (even), CS3282 can be in Sem 7 (odd). This works. So CS3281 must be in Sem 6. CS3282 in Sem 7. CS2102 in Sem 7. CS4218 in Sem 7. CS3210 in Sem 7? Student says 'definitely can't have CS2102 and CS3210 together'. So CS3210 cannot be in Sem 7. CS3210 must be in Sem 5 or Sem 6. CS3103 must be after CS3227. CS3227 must be before CS3103. CS3227 is offered Sem 1, Sem 2. CS3103 is offered Sem 1. So CS3227 can be Sem 5 or 6. CS3103 must be Sem 7 or later? No, CS3103 is only offered Sem 1. Sem 7 is Sem 1 of AY4. So CS3103 can be Sem 7. CS3227 must be before CS3103. So CS3227 in Sem 5 or 6. ATAP (CP3880) needs to be planned. CP3880 requires (IS2101 or ...) and (CS2103 or ...). Student has CS2103T. Prereq met. CP3880 is offered Sem 1, Sem 2, Special Terms. Student wants fewest semesters. Current is Sem 6. Remaining: Sem 6, 7, 8. Sem 6 is even (Sem 2). Sem 7 is odd (Sem 1). Sem 8 is even (Sem 2). Courses to plan: CS3281 (Sem 2 only), CS3282 (Sem 2 only), CS2102 (Sem 1,2), CS4218 (Sem 1,2), CS3210 (Sem 1,2), CS3227 (Sem 1,2), CS3103 (Sem 1 only), ATAP (Sem 1,2). Constraints: CS3281 in Sem 6 (only Sem 2 available before Sem 7 for CS3282). CS3282 in Sem 7 or 8. CS2102 in Sem 7. CS4218 in Sem 7. CS3210 NOT in Sem 7. So CS3210 in Sem 6 or 8. CS3227 before CS3103. CS3103 in Sem 7 (only Sem 1 option left, Sem 5 is past). So CS3103 in Sem 7. CS3227 in Sem 6 or 7. But CS3227 before CS3103, so CS3227 in Sem 6. ATAP in Sem 6, 7, or 8. If ATAP in Sem 6, it takes 12 MC. Sem 6 limit 20. CS3281 (4) + CS3227 (4) + ATAP (12) = 20 MC. This fits. Sem 7: CS2102 (4) + CS4218 (4) + CS3103 (4) = 12 MC. Fits. CS3210 needs to be placed. Not in Sem 7. Can be in Sem 8. Sem 8: CS3210 (4) + CS3282 (4) = 8 MC. Fits. So plan: Sem 6: CS3281, CS3227, CP3880. Sem 7: CS2102, CS4218, CS3103. Sem 8: CS3210, CS3282. Check prerequisites: CS3281 prereq CS2103T (done). CS3227 prereq CS2103T (done). CS3103 prereq CS2105 (done). CS2102 prereq CS1231S, CS2030S, CS2040S (done). CS4218 prereq CS3219 (done). CS3210 prereq CS2100 (done). CS3282 prereq CS3281 (planned Sem 6, so done in Sem 8). ATAP prereq CS2103T (done). All good. Fewest semesters? Ends in Sem 8. Can we end in Sem 7? No, CS3282 needs CS3281. If CS3281 in Sem 6, CS3282 in Sem 7. But Sem 7 has CS2102, CS4218, CS3103. That's 12 MC. Add CS3282 (4) = 16 MC. Add CS3210? No, CS3210 not in Sem 7. So Sem 7: CS2102, CS4218, CS3103, CS3282. 16 MC. Sem 6: CS3281, CS3227, CP3880. 20 MC. Sem 8: CS3210. 4 MC. This uses Sem 8. Can we move CS3210 to Sem 6? Sem 6 has CS3281, CS3227, CP3880. 4+4+12=20. No room for CS3210. Can we move CS3227 to Sem 5? Student is in Sem 6. "Plan my remaining semesters" starts from current semester. Current is Sem 6. So Sem 5 is past. Cannot plan Sem 5. So CS3227 must be Sem 6 or later. If CS3227 in Sem 7, it must be before CS3103. But CS3103 is in Sem 7. "Before" usually means strictly earlier semester. So CS3227 must be Sem 6. So Sem 6 is full with CS3281, CS3227, CP3880. Sem 7 has CS2102, CS4218, CS3103, CS3282. Sem 8 has CS3210. This is valid. Is there a way to avoid Sem 8? Only if CS3210 can be in Sem 7. But student said 'definitely can't have CS2102 and CS3210 together'. So CS3210 cannot be in Sem 7. So CS3210 must be Sem 8. So plan ends in Sem 8. This is the fewest semesters (8). Status PLAN.

Wait, check ATAP rule: "never in the last semester used". Last semester used is Sem 8. ATAP is in Sem 6. OK. "Other courses in ATAP semester total at most 8 MC". Sem 6 has CS3281 (4) + CS3227 (4) = 8 MC. OK.

Check CS3282 prerequisite: CS3281. CS3281 in Sem 6. CS3282 in Sem 7. OK.

Check CS3103 prerequisite: CS2105. Done.

Check CS3227 prerequisite: CS2103T. Done.

Check CS2102 prerequisite: CS1231S, CS2030S, CS2040S. Done.

Check CS4218 prerequisite: CS3219. Done.

Check CS3210 prerequisite: CS2100. Done.

All constraints satisfied.

One detail: "CS3103 must come before CS3227. Sorry, other way round: CS3227 must come before CS3103." So CS3227 < CS3103. Sem 6 < Sem 7. OK.

"CS2102 has to be in semester 7." OK.

"CS2102 and CS4218 must be in the same semester." Sem 7. OK.

"CS3282, CS2102 and CS3210, I need those as well." OK.

"CS3210 before CS3282." Student said "Ideally I'd take CS3210 before CS3282." This is a soft wish. In my plan, CS3210 is Sem 8, CS3282 is Sem 7. So CS3210 is AFTER CS3282. This violates the soft wish. Can I satisfy it?
If CS3210 before CS3282, CS3210 must be Sem 6 or 7.
Sem 7 cannot have CS3210 (conflict with CS2102).
Sem 6 cannot have CS3210 (full with CS3281, CS3227, CP3880).
So CS3210 cannot be before CS3282. The soft wish cannot be met.

Is there any other arrangement?
What if ATAP is in Sem 7?
Sem 7: CS2102, CS4218, CS3103, CP3880. 4+4+4+12=24 MC. Limit 20. Other courses max 8. 4+4+4=12 > 8. So ATAP cannot be in Sem 7 with these 3 courses.
What if ATAP is in Sem 8?
Sem 8: CP3880. Other courses max 8.
Sem 6: CS3281, CS3227. 8 MC.
Sem 7: CS2102, CS4218, CS3103, CS3282. 16 MC.
Sem 8: CP3880, CS3210. 12+4=16 MC. Other courses 4 <= 8. OK.
But ATAP cannot be in the last semester used. If Sem 8 is last, ATAP cannot be in Sem 8.
So ATAP must be Sem 6.

So the plan is fixed.

reasons: CS3281 and CS3227 are prerequisites for CS3282 and required before CS3103 respectively, fitting in Sem 6 with ATAP.
CS2102, CS4218, CS3103, and CS3282 are scheduled in Sem 7 as required or allowed.
CS3210 is placed in Sem 8 as it cannot be in Sem 7 due to conflict with CS2102.
